name: Velvet Carnation

yarn.description: Fine cotton yarn, bloom and centre colour

gauge: Gauge is not critical because the ruffled strip is gathered into the bloom. Yarn tension affects the final flower diameter.

steps.label: Row 1
steps.text: Leave a 60 centimetre starting tail. Ch 61. Starting in the second ch from hook, sc in each ch across; turn.

steps.label: Row 2
steps.text: Ch 2, which does not count as a st. Work 2 hdc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 3
steps.text: Ch 3, which does not count as a st. Work 2 dc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 4
steps.text: Ch 1, which does not count as a st. [Sk next st, 5 tr in next st, sk next st, sc in next st] 60 times. Fasten off, leaving a 15 centimetre tail.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: Make an MR. Ch 1, which does not count as a st, 6 sc in MR; sl st in first sc to join.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: Ch 1, which does not count as a st. Work 2 sc in each st around; sl st in first sc to join.

steps.label: Rnd 3
steps.text: Ch 1, which does not count as a st. [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times; sl st in first sc to join. Fasten off, leaving a 20 centimetre sewing tail.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: Make an MR. Ch 1, which does not count as a st, 9 sc in MR; sl st in first sc to join.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: [Ch 5, sl st in second ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, sl st in next sc] 9 times. Fasten off, leaving a 20 centimetre sewing tail.

assembly: Using the long starting tail, roll the Row 1 foundation edge of the petal strip into a tight, flat spiral, with the treble crochet scallops facing upward. Make small whip stitches through the foundation edge after each turn to secure the spiral.
Sew the centre over the exposed inner coils on the upper side of the gathered petal strip, using its sewing tail.
Centre the calyx on the underside of the gathered strip with its pointed sepals facing outward. Sew the calyx central ring securely to the flower base using its sewing tail.
finishing: Fasten off each piece after its final row or round, retaining the specified sewing tails for assembly.
Weave in the petal-strip tail and all remaining yarn ends on the reverse side of the flower.
Gently spread and arrange the treble crochet scallops to create a full, softly frilled carnation bloom.
notes: Keep the foundation edge tightly coiled during assembly; a compact centre gives the flower its gathered carnation shape.
For a deeper, moonlit effect, use a dusky wine, plum, or faded mauve bloom colour with the sage calyx.
